tagline.en: A mountain road up the Dahan River and over the Xueshan range from Daxi to the Lanyang plain
tagline.zh: 自大溪沿大汉溪上溯、越过雪山山脉下到兰阳平原的山区公路

start.zh: 桃园市大溪区，与台 3 线交会

end.en: Gongguan, Zhuangwei, Yilan, on Provincial Highway 2 by the coast
end.zh: 宜兰县壮围乡公馆，接滨海的台 2 线

en: Provincial Highway 7 runs 128.65 km from Daxi in Taoyuan to Gongguan on the Yilan coast, through Fuxing, Datong, Yuanshan and Yilan city. Only part of it is the Northern Cross-Island Highway proper: the highways directorate counts that as Daxi to the Baitao bridge at Qilan, about 82 km. From there the road follows the Lanyang River down to the plain.

It climbs the Dahan River past the mausoleums of Chiang Ching-kuo at Touliao and Chiang Kai-shek at Cihu, through Jiaobanshan, Luofu, Ronghua, Gaoyi and Baling, near Lalashan, to the Taoyuan–Yilan boundary at Xicun. The highest point, about 1,216 m, is near the 74 km mark beyond Mingchi; then come the hairpins of the Qilan descent.

It is an east–west road with an odd number, against the rule of Taiwan's numbering. Its course has been changed several times since the first highway census in 1961, when Highway 7 meant Yilan to Lishan; the present line, Daxi to Gongguan, dates from 1994. Four branches hang off it: 7A from Baitao bridge to Lishan on the Central Cross-Island Highway, 7B from Sanxia to Sanmin, 7C from Niudou to Lizejian and 7D from Shuanglianpi to Yilan.
zh: 台 7 线自桃园大溪至宜兰海滨的壮围公馆，途经复兴、大同、员山与宜兰市，全长 128.65 公里。其中只有一部分是严格意义上的北部横贯公路：公路总局将大溪至栖兰百韬桥约 82 公里称为北横。此后道路沿兰阳溪而下进入平原。
它沿大汉溪上溯，经头寮蒋经国陵寝与慈湖蒋中正陵寝，过角板山、罗浮、荣华、高义与巴陵（邻近拉拉山），至西村进入宜兰县境。全线最高点约在明池以东 74 公里处，海拔约 1,216 米；随后便是栖兰的九弯十八拐。
按台湾公路编号规则，东西向公路应编偶数，北横却是奇数。自 1961 年第一次公路普查以来，它的路线多次更动：当时台 7 线指的是宜兰至梨山；今天的大溪至公馆路线是 1994 年才定下的。主线另有四条支线：台 7 甲线自百韬桥至中横的梨山，台 7 乙线自三峡至三民，台 7 丙线自牛斗至利泽简，台 7 丁线自双连埤至宜兰。

en: Most of the road was made by widening what was there. Retired servicemen, several hundred of them, widened the old road for 40.6 km from Fuxing to Siling; the 30 or so km from Siling to Baitao bridge were built up from a logging road of the retired servicemen's forest-development office, which the highways directorate says saved two years.

What made the project hard was three long-span bridges over the gorges of the upper Dahan, a kind of structure Taiwan had no experience of. Daman bridge, later renamed Dahan, was a steel arch of 71.5 m over a gorge more than 80 m deep, then the longest-span steel arch in Taiwan; it was erected by cableway from both banks and met at the crown within 2 cm of the design. Baling was a suspension bridge 160 m long, whose anchorage needed a cavern about 10 m on a side cut into the rock. The third was the Fuxing suspension bridge at Luofu.
The Baling suspension bridge, only 4.5 m wide and approached through narrow tunnels, became a bottleneck on holidays and in the peach season. A new Baling Bridge downstream opened on 30 July 2005.
zh: 这条路大部分是在既有道路上拓宽而成。数百名退除役官兵依原有旧路拓宽复兴至四棱 40.6 公里；四棱至百韬桥约 30 公里，则以退辅会横贯公路森林开发处的运材道为基础整修，公路总局称此举节省了两年工期。
工程的难点在于跨越大汉溪上游峡谷的三座大跨径桥梁——当时台湾没有这类结构的技术与经验。大曼桥（后改名大汉桥）为跨度 71.5 米的钢拱桥，桥下溪谷深逾 80 米，是当时台湾跨度最大的钢拱桥；它以索道自两岸分节吊装，在拱顶合龙时与设计高程相差不到 2 厘米。巴陵吊桥长 160 米，为固定主索，须在岩壁上开凿约 10 米见方的锚碇岩洞。第三座是罗浮的复兴吊桥。
巴陵吊桥宽仅 4.5 米，前后接狭窄的隧道，每逢假日及水蜜桃盛产期间便成为交通瓶颈。下游新建的巴陵大桥于 2005 年 7 月 30 日通车。

en: The line began as Atayal hunting paths. Under Japanese rule it became a guard line built in 1910 against the Gaogan people, the Taoyuan–Yilan crossing trail of 1912 and the Jiaobanshan–Sanxing road of 1922, all of them footpaths. After the war the Provincial Highway Bureau took over the mountain roads and, from 1950 to 1952, cut and widened the road from Daxi to Jiaobanshan.

The bureau finished surveying a cross-island line in February 1958: up the Dahan from Fuxing, over the divide and down by Mingchi to Qilan, 71 km. Work was due to start in 1959 but was put off after that August's flood, which did more than NT$3.5 billion of damage. In August 1959 the forest-development office began its logging road from Baitao bridge to Siling, and the highway itself was begun on 1 May 1963.

It opened on 28 May 1966 at Dapu in Sanxia, with the vice-president, Yen Chia-kan, cutting the ribbon. The provincial governor, Huang Chieh, told the ceremony that the 92 km from Dapu to Datong had taken three years and been finished that April. The day after, the highway bureau began buses from Sanxia over the mountains to Baling and on to Yilan.

Much of what is known about the building comes from the diaries kept from 1954 to 2004 by Wu Lin, a works officer on the Daman and Baling bridges, which the highways directorate drew on for its 2015 history of the road. The bridges' site chief, Yen Chi-chang, later became director of the provincial highway bureau.

The mountain section is regularly cut by typhoons. When Typhoon Soudelor struck in August 2015 the directorate closed the road between Mingchi and Qilan, and the Xicun–Qilan stretch was not due to reopen until the morning of 10 August.
zh: 这条路线最早是泰雅族人的猎径。日治时期，1910 年日军为征讨高岗群（今三光）修筑隘勇线，1912 年修为桃宜横断线，1922 年再整修为角板山三星道路，当时都还是步道。战后山地道路由台湾省公路局接管，1950 年至 1952 年先完成大溪至角板山的开凿与拓宽。
公路局于 1958 年 2 月完成横贯路线的踏勘测量：自复兴溯大汉溪而上，越过分水岭，经明池下至栖兰，全长 71 公里。工程原定 1959 年开工，因当年八七水灾造成 35 亿元以上损失而缓办。1959 年 8 月，森林开发处先开始辟筑百韬桥至四棱的林道；公路本身则于 1963 年 5 月 1 日开工。
1966 年 5 月 28 日，在三峡大埔举行通车典礼，由副总统严家淦剪彩。省主席黄杰在致辞中说，自台北大埔至宜兰大同全长 92 公里，历时三载，于当年 4 月完成。通车次日起，公路局开行自三峡经复兴至巴陵、续往宜兰的班车。
今天对当年筑路经过的了解，很大一部分来自大曼桥、巴陵桥工程的工务员巫燐自 1954 年至 2004 年的完整工作日记；公路总局 2015 年出版的北横史书即以此为据。两座大桥的施工所主任严启昌，日后出任省公路局长。
山区路段常因台风中断。2015 年 8 月苏迪勒台风来袭，公路总局封闭明池至栖兰路段，西村至栖兰段直到 8 月 10 日早上才预定抢通。

en: Rhythms Monthly gives the total works cost of the 1963–1966 highway as NT$105 million. None of the sources found says where the money came from; they name the Provincial Highway Bureau as the builder, working with the retired servicemen's commission, whose men supplied much of the labour.
Fares on the first buses, as reported in the United Daily News, were NT$17.5 from Sanxia to Baling and NT$44 from Sanxia to Yilan.
zh: 据《经典》杂志，1963 年至 1966 年兴建北横的总工程费为新台币 1 亿 500 万元。所见资料都没有说明经费来源，只说明由台湾省公路局兴建，并与退辅会合作，由荣民提供大部分人力。
据《联合报》报道，通车初期的班车票价为三峡至巴陵 17.5 元、三峡至宜兰 44 元。

en: Limits are 25 to 60 km/h. Expect slow traffic around Baling at weekends and in the peach season. At Qilan, Highway 7A turns off south for Wuling farm and Lishan; ahead, Highway 7 descends the Lanyang valley to Yilan.
zh: 速限为每小时 25 至 60 公里。周末及水蜜桃产季，巴陵一带车行缓慢。在栖兰可转台 7 甲线南行往武陵农场与梨山；台 7 线本身则沿兰阳溪谷下至宜兰。

value.en: NT$105 million, total works cost, 1963–1966. A single magazine source; not checked against the highway bureau's accounts.
value.zh: 1963—1966 年总工程费新台币 1 亿 500 万元。仅见于一篇杂志报道，未与公路局账目核对。

figures.source: 林日揚, 「北台灣的時光走廊 北橫公路台七線」, Rhythms Monthly (經典雜誌), 台灣之路 series

why.en: The sources found name the builders — the Taiwan Provincial Highway Bureau, with labour and a logging road from the Vocational Assistance Commission for Retired Servicemen — but not who paid.
why.zh: 所见资料只说明兴建单位——台湾省公路局，并由退除役官兵辅导委员会提供人力与运材道——未说明经费由谁负担。

value.en: 128.650 km, Daxi to Gongguan; the Northern Cross-Island Highway proper, Daxi to Baitao bridge, about 82 km
value.zh: 大溪至公馆 128.650 公里；其中大溪至百韬桥的北横公路约 82 公里

figures.source: Executive Yuan, 公告調整省道台7線路線, 5 February 2021, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 台7線; Directorate General of Highways, as reported in United Daily News, 「台7線多長、哪一段稱北橫？」, May 2021

value.en: Steel arch, 71.5 m span, over a gorge more than 80 m deep; the longest-span steel arch in Taiwan when built
value.zh: 钢拱桥，跨度 71.5 米，桥下溪谷深逾 80 米；建成时为台湾跨度最大的钢拱桥

figures.source: 林日揚, 「北台灣的時光走廊 北橫公路台七線」, Rhythms Monthly (經典雜誌)

value.en: Taiwan Provincial Highway Bureau (Jiaobanshan–Siling), with retired servicemen; the retired servicemen's forest-development office (Baitao bridge–Siling logging road)
value.zh: 台湾省公路局（角板山至四棱），动员退除役官兵；退辅会横贯公路森林开发处（百韬桥至四棱运材道）

figures.source: 李瑞宗, 問路北橫, Directorate General of Highways, 2015 (publisher's description); Directorate General of Highways, as reported in United Daily News, May 2021

timeline.en: The Japanese rebuild the trail as the Jiaobanshan–Sanxing road, still a footpath.
timeline.zh: 日人将步道整修为角板山三星道路，仍为步行道。

timeline.en: The Provincial Highway Bureau completes the survey of the cross-island line in February.
timeline.zh: 2 月，台湾省公路局完成横贯路线踏勘测量。

timeline.en: The planned start is postponed after the August flood; work on the Baitao–Siling logging road begins.
timeline.zh: 八七水灾后原定开工延后；百韬桥至四棱林道开始辟筑。

timeline.en: Work on the highway begins on 1 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 1 日北横公路开工。

timeline.en: The road opens on 28 May at Dapu, Sanxia.
timeline.zh: 5 月 28 日在三峡大埔举行通车典礼。

timeline.en: County Road 194 is merged in, giving the present route from Daxi to Gongguan.
timeline.zh: 县道 194 号并入，形成今日大溪至公馆的路线。

timeline.en: The new Baling Bridge opens on 30 July.
timeline.zh: 7 月 30 日，巴陵大桥通车。

timeline.en: Typhoon Soudelor closes the mountain section in August.
timeline.zh: 8 月苏迪勒台风致山区路段封闭。

timeline.en: The Executive Yuan gazettes a minor adjustment of the route on 5 February.
timeline.zh: 2 月 5 日，行政院公告微调台 7 线路线。
